title: Honey Glazed Pork Tenderloin
description: Oven-roasted pork tenderloin glazed with a sticky soy-honey mustard sauce — impressive enough for guests, easy enough for weeknights.
steps: Cook rice in 125g salted water, covered, 12–15 minutes.
Mix soy sauce, honey, mustard and garlic powder into a glaze.
Sear pork tenderloin in oil on medium-high, all sides, 2 minutes total. Transfer to baking dish; coat with glaze.
Bake at 200°C / 400°F for 18–20 minutes until internal temp reaches 63°C / 145°F. Rest 3 minutes before slicing.
Serve sliced over rice with any remaining glaze spooned over.
notes: Use a meat thermometer — pork tenderloin overcooks quickly. 63°C is perfectly juicy.
